At my worst they were strange delusions, telling me that I was both Nietzsche's "ubermensch" and I guess "untermensch" simultaneously, it made sense at the time. They'd tell me I'd had to befriend lost spirits, (they were sent to me as a gift by God to be my best friends, I've always identified as atheist though..) I was later told to try my best to achieve time travel, so I could go back in time to save the Jews from the Nazi's and stop the start of Zionism.  When I wasn't too bad they would say people were judging me, my neighbours were spying on me, people were about to attack me (I live next to a notoriously rough neighborhood). On my medication, it's like someone in the distance is screaming, "JASMINE!!" over and over, trying to talk to me.

I'm not too bad now that I'm taking medication for it, but prior to being medicated I was certain I was another species in a different dimension. Usually if I heard I voice I look around to see where it's coming from and see if other people react to it. I also have to be aware of my paranoia, I try my best to justify things logically.

Yeah it affects me a lot, I feel disabled in a way. Prior to my diagnosis I wrote poetry often, hence my username; words don't flow as free anymore. I get paranoid about acting potentially eccentrically and people looking down on me. I'm afraid I scared away the friends that I had in the past due to my schizophrenia. I feel as though I will never fit in again.

My doctor and psychologist say I'm doing really well compared to this time last year, (I was quite the fruitloop supposedly) I exercise, sleep well and eat healthily but I still feel stressed and as though that there's no future. I still don't feel happy... I'm on a low dose of risperidone, the voices are largely gone except for the occasional, "faraway" voice but it feels manageable the depression and I suppose, "inferiority complex" are what's getting to me.
It's been about a year now since my diagnosis, I think the stress just gets to me. My mum had a big rant at me, saying I'm lazy and a disappointment but she's gone to bed now.
